embargo-bot: Embargo set for 2024-04-12T18:00:00Z. Reminders scheduled 24h and 1h prior.

Aria (Content): Added CTA: "Request a trial  routes to your region" and sample UTMs: campaign=quietwave_spot, source=social, medium=cta, tag=cw-case.
Marcus (Legal): Uploaded legal_redlines_quietwave.pdf. If they sign later we can append the number with a signed addendum. Also requested explicit consent for product name mention.
June (Prod Marketing): I emailed QuietWave legal for consent and scheduled a 15-min signoff call tomorrow 9:00 PT. If consent isn't returned by EOD Wed, publish with conservative language and still run webinar.
Rita (Demand): Once legal clears I'll queue the post and build the registration page. Tag @Noah when the page is live so he can wire the webhook and AE rotation.
Noah (Sales): I'll prepare the Slack alert template for incoming leads. Sample payload I'll take from Aria and mirror to our endpoint.
Aria (Content): Social variants uploaded: quietwave_social_tech.txt and quietwave_social_prod.txt (both <280 chars).
June (Prod Marketing): Thanks team. Follow-ups: Marcus final signoff after consent, QuietWave response, Noah routing ready, Rita reg page and press queue. Back here after the signoff call. :thumbsup:
